title: Add a checkbox "this network is metered" with required "yes/no" input below the password prompt
line: When you connect to a new Wi-Fi network, you can now mark it as metered right below the password field.
explanation: A connection could only be marked as metered in the connection editor (System Settings or Configure…), so most networks such as phone hotspots stayed 'automatic' and apps and update tools had nothing to go on. The Networks widget's password prompt for a new network had no way to set it. The prompt now has a "Metered connection" checkbox with an info button explaining what it means; when ticked, the new connection is saved with metered set to Yes, otherwise it keeps the default (automatic).

commits.message:
applet: let users mark a new Wi-Fi network as metered when connecting

Marking a network as metered was only possible in the connection editor,
so most people never did it. The password prompt for a new network now
has a "Metered connection" checkbox that is saved with the connection.

BUG: 479317

media.caption: Connecting to a new network: only the password field.
The prompt now has a "Metered connection" checkbox (with an info button) under the password.
